_comment: SK_WAND with reflections disabled, for the water attenuation-length measurement only. The reference (Utilities/scattable/AttenL) fits a0*exp(-x/L) to h_direct/h_all with isct<1000, i.e. reflected photons excluded from both histograms; switching reflection off reproduces that selection exactly, because LUCiD reports one 'indirect' flag that ORs scattering with reflection. NOT for physics production.

trigger._note: SK trigger: HK's n_thr=45 scaled by the PMT ratio (11096/19746=0.562). Validated 2026-07-23 with lucid.production.trigger_study on WAND/SK/GeV config_06: 300 events, physics efficiency 100.0% on every event, 1-5 gates/event.
